soc_soe.single_root_cause_hypothesis: The rejected learned regressors were approximating an exact causal ratio already defined by cumulative charge or energy and the fixed pre-cycle reference; approximation error, not label-feature misalignment, caused the remaining SOC/SOE coverage failure after v10 repair.
soc_soe.minimum_falsifiable_experiment: On the unchanged strict held-out endpoints, score the transparent causal ratio as a named non-trained baseline beside the learned candidates. Reject the hypothesis if its held-out coverage is below 100% or any prefix changes after a future-tail perturbation.

soh.nominal_definition_warning: CALCE files aggregate long drive traces and produce 6-7 Ah apparent capacity, so a 1.1 Ah nominal denominator is not comparable for lifecycle SOH.
soh.single_root_cause_hypothesis: The main SOH failure is unseen charging-policy trajectory shift rather than the choice between first-complete and train-cell statistical normalization; their largest mean shifts are only about 1.94% and 1.65%, while the rejected smoke SOH MAE was about 5.77%.
soh.minimum_falsifiable_experiment: Using the unchanged first-complete SOH definition and strict folds, stratify existing-model residuals by held-out policy and cycle range. Reject the hypothesis if residual magnitude is not concentrated in unseen-policy or out-of-range trajectory regions.

matr.eol: official cycle_life at 0.88 Ah, 80% of nominal capacity

oxford.eol: first observed capacity at or below 80% of first complete cycle

rul.single_root_cause_hypothesis: Joint RUL regression conflates two different supervision protocols and lifetime domains despite both labels being expressed in physical cycles.
rul.minimum_falsifiable_experiment: Keep the same causal feature set and model family, but evaluate source-stratified strict held-out tasks with separately reported acceptance. Reject the hypothesis if both source-specific errors remain as large as the joint error.

decision: v10 data and Phase 1/2 diagnostics pass. A new strict smoke run may be considered only after chief-engineer approval; formal training remains prohibited.
